name: material-interface

sections.heading: Scope and constraints
sections.text: The admitted source-facing binary .ni profile supplies public Int constants with original symbol/type identity; a metadata-only interface cannot manufacture an executable value. Provider-source and material-interface consumers must agree.

sections.heading: Use and remediation
sections.text: Follow the admitted forms in the individual syntax and operator references. Keep source order and type identity; make imports and capability grants explicit. A native supplemental contract does not introduce source constructors or widen target support.

sections.heading: Negative example applicability
sections.text: No distinct source trigger is asserted for this definition. The associated native/CLI boundary tests below are supplementary evidence, not a fabricated source rejection.
